messages.author: f07e177d146b22ac
messages.subject: Using dplyr with RC objects
parts: I have several large datasets composed of reference classes in R...is there any way I could store these objects in a table using dplyr? By what I've seen, native R does not allow for storing RC objects in data frames(correct me if I'm wrong). I have tried extending the data frame class to support advanced objects, however doing so prevents me from being able to read and write these objects to/from a file system. Any ideas on how this could be solved using dplyr?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Using dplyr with RC objects
parts:
Yes, just put them in a list.
Hadley
